reviews.text:
We've been taking our cats to this clinic for many years! Dr. Nagai always examines them. He's never recommended any unnecessary tests; in fact, he gently dissuades anxious pet owners (lol).
The nurses are all wonderful, and I'm always so happy that they speak kindly to my cats.
The consultation fees are also reasonably priced, so I can visit without any worries.
This is definitely a hospital I'd like to continue using!
The head doctor, as well as the other doctors and nurses, are all very kind and provide thorough explanations, so I feel confident entrusting my care to them.

As mentioned in other reviews, the head veterinarian is not a great doctor.

He started doing things like nail trimming without being asked, and it was listed on the invoice.

Informed consent was not properly given, and surgery fees and other charges were added later.

This animal hospital lacks integrity.

They repeatedly told me to judge based on numbers and just see my pet through to the end, but they didn't examine my pet properly and are a veterinarian who cannot empathize with the feelings of pet owners.

My pet recovered after I switched to a different hospital for a second opinion.

They were the worst veterinarian and nurse.

On January 2nd, my dog's ear suddenly started acting up, and as my regular veterinary clinic was closed, I went to this nearby clinic.
It was the beginning of the year and I was worried about not being able to find a place to take him, but they treated me with kindness and performed all the necessary tests in detail.

After the examination, they also kindly explained future care in a way that was easy to understand, which put me at ease.

I can't thank the doctor and all the staff enough.

Thank you so much.

My cat had blood in her urine on January 2nd, so I looked for a hospital that was open and took her in. When I called, I found out they were by appointment only and the waiting time was short. The veterinarian was easy to talk to and examined her thoroughly. She also explained the necessity of things like ultrasounds properly, and was a really good doctor.

What a wonderful teacher!

Thank you so much for your warm support until the very end, both for our beloved dog who passed away in March and for us!

They don't do anything unnecessary, they ask other doctors if they don't know something, they're not arrogant, and they're accurate.

They took care of my previous dog until the end. I consider Dr. Yoneyama my benefactor because he never gave up on my dog ​​and fought alongside me until the very end. All the staff are wonderful too. Now my 3-year-old dog is in their care.

As everyone has said, both doctors are kind and thorough in their examinations and are willing to give advice. They have a good reputation among my family and neighbors.

As a veterinary clinic, they are well-equipped.

However, the more you worry, the more tests you will have to go through, and the higher the fees.

Blood tests, X-rays, ultrasounds, and medications can add up to a significant amount.

Please be prepared when visiting.

I moved and went to this hospital because my previous one was far away. It was a bit too thorough, perhaps a little too long? Maybe it's good for some people?

Also, despite two other hospitals saying my patellar luxation was "still okay," this hospital strongly recommended surgery. Is this doctor just eager to perform surgery or something? I think I'll wait and see for a while.

There are many misdiagnoses.

He's a wonderful teacher.

The assistants are also incredibly kind and speak to me kindly.

I always ask them for help, including last time.

I'm truly grateful for the attentive and caring way you always listen to my concerns.

Both doctors listen carefully, and the nurses are incredibly friendly and pleasant.

They also explain the costs beforehand, which makes me feel very confident in their services.

My dog ​​has been treated for numerous illnesses at this hospital. Everything is done in-house. I think it's truly wonderful. There are two doctors, and since it's by appointment only, there's no waiting. The nurses are also very dedicated, kind, and good at conversation. Honestly, there's no better animal hospital. There are many animals, but they remember almost all of their names. Above all, their skills are excellent, and their diagnosis and treatment are appropriate. We will continue to use their services in the future.
I visited the clinic for the first time in three years. The staff were very friendly and helpful, which made me feel at ease during my visit.
They're only interested in making money. They perform excessive tests repeatedly, but there's no effort put into innovative treatments. I went there for a long time, and it was the worst experience.

I've been to several veterinary clinics, but this is the best I've ever been to. Not only are the procedures done carefully, but everyone welcomes you with a warm smile. I personally love that Radiohead is playing in the background in such a gentle atmosphere.
